notes.title: Girls Collection Bundle Release!
notes.notes:
Girls Collection is a bundle of 4 puzzle games combines with classic gameplay, chill atmosphere and of course a lot of adorable girls!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/20625/Girls_Collection/

Friendly-will-solve-them-for-u assistant

Solve puzzles and chill
